title: Shopify SSLCommerz Payment Middleware
description: Node.js and TypeScript middleware on Express and MongoDB, linking Shopify to SSLCommerz via the Shopify Admin API. Verifies every payment with the gateway and records it as a manual-payment order, avoiding Shopify's third-party transaction fee. Deployed with the live store and tested end to end against the SSLCommerz sandbox, ready for a live merchant account.

title: Zoom Attendance for Moodle
description: Moodle plugin that turns the session data the Zoom plugin already stores into per-class attendance for students and teachers: interval-union time clipped to each class, rosters frozen when a class ends, logged corrections, PHPUnit/Behat tests and CI on Moodle 4.1–5.0. Designed, reviewed and tested by me; implementation AI-assisted.

title: Moodle Patch Manager
description: Moodle plugins that apply, verify and roll back patches to third-party plugins on a production site: dry runs, pristine backups, audit history and a CLI-first workflow. The first pack fixes the Zoom plugin's duration-based grading. Designed, reviewed and tested by me; implementation AI-assisted.

title: Jolly Learning Bangladesh
description: Production Shopify storefront for Jolly Learning UK's local partner in Bangladesh: theme and Liquid customization, product setup, SEO and deployment. Takes orders by cash on delivery and workshop registrations by manual bKash/Nagad payment; the SSLCommerz checkout is built and waiting on a live merchant account.

title: Upstream fix for Moodle's Zoom plugin
description: Reported that Moodle's Zoom plugin records attendance for recurring meetings but never grades it, and argued for a fix over removing the feature. The maintainer agreed to a focused PR that grades each occurrence; it passes CI and is in review.

title: Fulkopi
description: Full-stack MERN store with Google OAuth and JWT authentication, role-based access control, an admin dashboard, and SSLCommerz checkout on a Docker-ready Express backend.

title: Inventory Management System
description: REST API and React/Redux dashboard for products, purchases, sales, returns, and expenses. A purchase, sale or return and its line items are written and deleted in one MongoDB transaction.

title: Calisthenics-Guides (NextJS+TS+Tailwind)
description: Calisthenics workout and routine guide built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Exercise pages, routines, and progressions are driven by type-safe data models and server-side rendering.

title: Task Manager Website
description: Task management web application on the MERN stack — React and Redux on the frontend, Express.js and MongoDB on the backend — with user login and task CRUD operations.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This site: a React and Vite single-page app with client-side routing, light and dark themes, and all content in static JSON files. The contact form sends mail through EmailJS, so there is no backend to run.
